tests.name: json_view_compare_identical_objects
tests.intent: Verify comparison between two identical JSON documents using json_document and json_view without temporary vector allocations.

tests.name: json_view_compare_ordered_json
tests.intent: Verify comparison of ordered_json views with duplicate keys resolved efficiently in a shared working vector.

tests.name: json_view_compare_different_types
tests.intent: Verify comparison between views pointing to different JSON types returns false.

tests.name: json_view_compare_array_sizes
tests.intent: Verify that arrays of different sizes are rejected immediately during comparison pre-checks.

tests.name: json_view_compare_numbers_direct
tests.intent: Verify direct numerical comparison of numbers of the same type without promotion to basic_json.

tests.name: json_view_compare_mixed_number_types
tests.intent: Verify number comparison across different types (e.g. integer vs float) via fallback mechanisms.

tests.name: json_view_editable_document_flag
tests.intent: Verify that is_editable static constexpr member is correctly defined on basic_json_view for editable documents.

tests.name: json_view_load_image_check_full
tests.intent: Verify image loading with full check utilizing the optimized plain float token scanner and fast range sorting.

tests.name: json_view_load_image_check_basic
tests.intent: Verify image loading with basic check option.

tests.name: json_view_compare_lockstep_walk
tests.intent: Verify lockstep document text walk optimization during view comparisons on deeply nested structures.

tests.name: json_view_compare_object_keys_order
tests.intent: Verify standard json object comparison handles key order independence correctly.

tests.name: json_view_compare_ordered_object_keys_order
tests.intent: Verify ordered_json object comparison strictly follows document insertion order of keys.

tests.name: json_view_compare_small_insertion_sort
tests.intent: Verify object member sorting logic using insertion sort for small object keys (<= 16 members).

tests.name: json_view_editable_document_comparison
tests.intent: Verify comparison between editable json document views.

tests.name: json_view_compare_unequal_lengths
tests.intent: Verify comparison of strings or arrays with different lengths or contents.

tests.name: json_view_empty_containers
tests.intent: Verify comparison and handling of empty objects and empty arrays.

tests.name: json_view_boolean_and_null
tests.intent: Verify comparison of boolean and null values via json views.

tests.name: json_view_string_escaping_comparison
tests.intent: Verify comparison of strings containing escape sequences.

tests.name: json_view_nested_array_comparison
tests.intent: Verify deep nested array comparison correctness.

tests.name: json_view_large_object_keys_comparison
tests.intent: Verify comparison of objects with more than 16 members triggering fallback sorting paths.
